findings.evidence: `rg -n "change " code/TauCeti/KnotTheory/Grid/Cycles.lean` reports line 94: `change LinearMap.range G.fullyBlockedDifferential ≤ LinearMap.ker G.fullyBlockedDifferential`; the wrappers are defined at lines 46 and 50.
findings.fix: Replace the `change` with an explicit rewrite/unfold step such as `rw [fullyBlockedBoundaries, fullyBlockedCycles]` before applying `LinearMap.range_le_ker_iff`, or add a comment justifying why no rewrite/lemma is available.
findings.issue: `fullyBlockedBoundaries_le_cycles` uses `change` to replace the named submodules by `LinearMap.range`/`LinearMap.ker` without documenting why definitional equality is needed.

summary: One proof uses an undocumented `change` to cross the local cycle/boundary wrappers, which is exactly the fragile definitional-equality pattern this rubric asks to avoid.
